title: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.20509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative super-resolution (SR) can recover sharp detail in computed tomography (CT) images from severely downsampled observations, but the missing high-frequency content is not uniquely determined by the low-resolution input. Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. To overcome this challenge, we introduce VascuSR, an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance. First, to provide richer anatomical guidance, we use an explicit 3D vascular representation that captures structural information beyond individual slices. This representation also simplifies vascular refinement by allowing a lightweight 3D generative refiner to focus on vascular structure rather than complex CT appearance. Second, to guide slice-wise SR, a lightweight anatomy controller

translated_title: VascuSR：用于CT超分辨率的迭代式解剖感知扩散模型
translated_abstract: 生成式超分辨率（SR）可以从严重下采样的观测中恢复计算机断层扫描（CT）图像的清晰细节，但缺失的高频内容并非由低分辨率输入唯一确定。因此，视觉上看似合理的重建结果可能包含解剖学上不支持的血管细节，例如缺失的、虚假的或错误连接的血管。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了VascuSR，这是一个迭代式的解剖感知扩散框架，它将图像重建与显式的3D血管引导相结合。首先，为了提供更丰富的解剖学引导，我们使用显式的3D血管表示来捕捉单个切片之外的结构信息。这种表示还简化了血管细化过程，使轻量级的3D生成细化器能够专注于血管结构而非复杂的CT外观。其次，为了引导逐切片的超分辨率，一个轻量级的解剖控制器……
tldr: VascuSR提出了一种将图像重建与显式3D血管引导相结合的迭代式解剖感知扩散框架，有效解决了CT超分辨率重建中血管细节缺失、虚假或错误连接的问题。
en_tdlr: VascuSR introduces an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance to prevent anatomically unsupported vascular details (such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels) in CT super-resolution.
